scope: Card roles for deck archetype naming: which cards are win conditions (and at which priority tier, implying which family), which are bait units, which are bridge partners. Community vocabulary, one public source per entry; never a quality claim. A card absent here is not a win condition.
grammar: docs/deck-archetypes.md in this repo; the classifier is elixir-mcp packages/contracts archetypes.ts

fields.tier: priority when the card anchors a deck's name (lower first); null for a bait win condition whose tier depends on bait_tiers; heavy tanks are ordered 2.0-2.5 (Golem, Lava Hound, Electro Giant, Goblin Giant, Elixir Golem, Three Musketeers) so a deck with two names by the bigger tank; 10 is the spell-only anchor (Rocket), below every troop and building win condition; the chip and bridge win conditions are ordered 9.0-9.35 (Hog Rider, Ram Rider, Royal Hogs, Battle Ram, Miner, Goblin Drill, Wall Breakers, Minion Giant) so a deck with two names by the one the community leads with, never by card id
fields.family: the family the win condition implies
fields.at_cycle_cost: the family instead when the deck's average elixir is at or under the cycle bound
fields.needs_partner: the family applies only with a bridge_partner in the deck, else control
fields.pairs_with: cards that join as a second win condition when present, optionally moving the family
fields.bait_tiers: minimum bait units in the deck -> tier
fields.bait_unit: a spell-vulnerable swarm card (the bait package test)
fields.bridge_partner: a fast bridge unit (the P.E.K.K.A / Mega Knight / Ram Rider test)
